notes.content:
RESULT (2026-07-16, cargo publish --dry-run, both EXIT 0): BOTH PUBLISHABLE NOW.
- tuas_boussinesq_solver v0.1.3: packaged + verify-built + reached Uploading (dry-run). Only internal dep is chem-eng as a DEV-dep; publish verify builds the LIBRARY only, so dev-deps do NOT block.
- tampines-steam-tables v0.2.1: same — internal crates (tuas/teh-o-prke/chem-eng) are dev-deps only; library deps are all crates.io (approx/ndarray/thiserror/uom).
Caveats: (1) --dry-run does NOT check if the version already exists on crates.io — confirm 0.1.3 / 0.2.1 aren't already taken, bump if needed (do NOT auto-bump per CLAUDE.md). (2) Actual publish needs the user's crates.io credentials + crate ownership — AI must not use credentials; user runs 'cargo publish -p <crate>'. (3) If downstream should be able to run the PUBLISHED crates' test suites, publish the dev-dep chain first (chem-eng -> teh-o-prke -> tuas -> tampines); not required to publish the libraries themselves.

title: Check cargo-publish readiness for tampines-steam-tables + tuas_boussinesq_solver

description:
From the op-ffg6 audit, 2026-08-13. Highest value per unit risk in the whole programme. NON-API-BREAKING, zero downstream impact. ~2-3 days. Depends on C1.

These are sites whose ENCLOSING FUNCTION ALREADY RETURNS Result, so the fix is a ? (or a collect) and nothing else:
  - 85 pub fns already returning Result
  - 16 private fns already returning Result
  - 60 panic-macros already inside Result-returning fns
  - all 26 lock/join sites (22 Mutex::lock().unwrap() + 4 JoinHandle::join().unwrap())

INCLUDES THE MOTIVATING CRASH, at zero API cost:
  one_d_solid_array_with_lateral_coupling/calculation.rs:95   (the reported panic)
  one_d_fluid_array_with_lateral_coupling/calculation.rs:127  (its twin)
  advance_timestep already returns Result<(), TuasLibError> in both modules (calculation.rs:21 and :22 respectively).
  SHAPE CAVEAT: Array1 has no Result FromIterator blanket impl, so this needs collect::<Result<Vec<_>,_>>()? followed by
  Array1::from_vec -- one extra allocation per node-array per timestep. It short-circuits so it should not be measurably
  slower, but it runs per node per timestep: BENCHMARK IT, do not assume.

Biggest single file: fluid_mechanics_correlations/churchill_friction_factor.rs -- 15 panic! inside fns that already
return Result<f64, TuasLibError> (e.g. fanning at :112 panics at :114/:118/:122).

LAND THIS FIRST. When it lands, the reported htgr_sim_v1 crash (op-m1jz / op-szmi.17) closes on the TUAS side.
title: C2 TUAS: the free wins -- ~187 non-breaking unwrap/panic conversions, INCLUDING the htgr_sim_v1 crash

description: Insert graded near-wall PRISM (inflation) layers at selected wall boundary patches before/around the volume fill -- the 'optional wall boundary layer addon'. Parameters: layer count, first-layer thickness / expansion ratio, per-patch selection. Critical for CFD wall treatment (y+ resolution) in the reactor TH. Eventually driven from the GUI. Depends on the volume mesher (tet/poly) + wall-patch tagging. V&V: prism layers on a channel wall have the requested count + graded thickness, cells non-inverted, watertight.
title: outram-blender: wall boundary-layer / prism-layer insertion (GUI addon target)
